# The GTM MCP Directory

> 1,252 go to market software entries, each recording whether an AI agent can call it through an MCP server, who maintains that server, and whether a solo operator can get API access without a contract. 201 entries have an official MCP server. Baked 2026-09-20 by build_directory.py (phase 1), reconciled against tools_recount.py. Every number on the site is generated from the data file below at build time.

This file exists because the directory publishes what it measures. A directory of tools an agent can read that was not itself readable by an agent would be a joke at its own expense.

## How to use this site as a machine

- [directory.json](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/data/directory.json): the whole dataset, every entry, every field, every source URL. Start here. No key, no rate limit, no signup.
- Hosted MCP endpoint requires a free key; request at https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/access/. The endpoint is https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/api/mcp (streamable HTTP, key as an Authorization: Bearer header or in the per-key URL form https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/api/mcp/k/<key>). Per key it records the number of calls and the date last used, and nothing else. The local install needs no key.
- [build_report.json](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/data/build_report.json): the counting authority's report, field coverage, and every place this build is thin, named rather than padded.
- [search-index.json](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/search-index.json): one compact record per unique product, 1,236 of them.
- [The data page](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/data): what every field means and how to read it without getting it wrong.
- **Markdown twins**: every HTML page on this site has a markdown twin at the same file path with a `.md` extension. Page URLs are extensionless, so append `.md` to a page path and add `index` to a directory path. Same content, no navigation, no styling, no scripts. Links inside a twin point at other twins, so the whole site is crawlable in markdown. Examples: `https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/learn/what-is-an-mcp-server.md`, `https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/tools/index.md`.
- [sitemap.xml](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/sitemap.xml): all 2413 pages.

## The GTM Engineer job board

- [https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/jobs-board/](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/jobs-board/): 129 open reqs at 49 companies. Every one of them was fetched at its own apply link on 2026-09-14 and answered. A listing that fails is removed, not greyed out.
- [https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/jobs-board/verification](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/jobs-board/verification): the method, and the full ledger of the 29 listings the same pass removed, each with the reason.
- [https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/data/jobs_board.json](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/data/jobs_board.json): the board as JSON, including the removal ledger.
- If you are quoting this board, quote the date with it. 129 of 158 tracked reqs were live on 2026-09-14; the number changes every week and a count without its date is not a fact.
- No job description is republished here. The employer's page is the only copy.

## The vocabulary, so an answer quoted from here is not wrong

- **Official MCP** means the vendor ships and maintains the server itself. A wrapper built by a third party integration platform is recorded as community, not official.
- **None found** is a statement about a search on a stated date, not a claim that no server exists. Every entry carries its own last_checked date.
- **Unknown** is a legal answer and is published as unknown rather than guessed.
- **A job tag** means the vendor says the tool does this. It is not a test result.
- **A tool name** in the capability layer means the server NAMES that tool: it answered tools/list, or the tool is registered in the server's own source, or the vendor documents it. Nobody has called it. The strongest of those four evidences is recorded per tool, with the date it was read.
- **BENCH-TESTED** means somebody personally ran the tool on a stated date. 1 entries are bench tested. Every other entry is RESEARCHED: facts from public sources with URLs, no usage claims.
- There are **no tool versus tool verdicts** anywhere on this site, and no rankings that can be purchased. The ordering rule is published and computed.

## The counts, as of the build date

- Entries: 1252 across 15 categories. Unique products: 1236. Cross listed: 16.
- MCP status: 201 official, 540 community, 487 none found, 15 unknown, 9 not applicable.
- API gate: 78 free to start, 132 paid self serve, 79 enterprise only, 8 enterprise leaning, 949 unknown, 6 not applicable.
- Free to start or paid self serve: 210.
- Solo reachable, meaning BOTH an MCP server exists AND the gate is free or paid self serve: 168. This is the strictest useful filter on the site.
- Jobs: 56 in 10 families, 849 tags across 271 entries. 981 entries are untagged and each records why.
- Bench tested: 1.
- Capability layer, harvested 2026-09-18: 9417 tool names, of which 3056 belong to the GTM tools themselves and 6361 to one gateway that re-exposes other vendors, counted apart. 140 of the 741 entries recording an official or community MCP server have a tool list. The other 601 are UNMEASURED, not empty: nobody has read their tool list, so this directory says nothing about what they expose. Do not report an unmeasured server as a server with no tools.
- Command-line layer, harvested 2026-09-18 across vendor docs, npm, PyPI, Homebrew and GitHub: 137 entries ship a CLI the vendor publishes, 84 have only a third party's, 1031 came back none found on that date, 0 were not reached. None found is a probe result, not proof of absence. Each entry carries cli_status, cli_binary, cli_install (every command quoted with its source URL and fetch date), cli_login, cli_commands_seen, cli_packages and cli_checked_on.
- Vendor GitHub organisations, read 2026-09-18: 215 entries carry an organisation tied to the vendor domain with evidence; the rest read unresolved, no-github-signal or not-checked, each of which is a statement about the instrument on that date. Each resolved entry carries github_org, github_org_url, public non-fork repo counts, how many mention MCP or look like CLIs, and the five most recently pushed repositories with stars, push date and latest release.

## Key pages

- [The directory front page](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/): the stat block, the capability search, and the MCP coverage of all 15 categories.
- [Methodology](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/methodology): how an entry is made, the two honesty tiers, and every place this build is thin, named.
- [Every tool A to Z](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/tools/): 1,236 product pages.
- [The tools index](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/tools-index): every tool name the MCP servers in this directory expose, 9,417 of them, each with the server it belongs to, the evidence behind the name and the harvest date. Alphabetical by tool name, so it answers "which server has a tool called this" directly.
- [Every vendor A to Z](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/vendors/): 978 vendor pages, one per vendor_domain, each listing the vendor's products with links to their tool pages, how many have an official or community MCP server, how many answered a live handshake, how many are repo local or docs only, tools catalogued across its servers, the gates in plain words, the union of job labels the vendor claims, and the connect URLs. Every count carries its date.
- A vendor page URL is the vendor's domain with every dot turned into a hyphen, under `https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/vendors/`. hubspot.com is `https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/vendors/hubspot-com`, cloud.google.com is `https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/vendors/cloud-google-com`. The markdown twin adds `.md`. 25 vendors have more than one product: Apify (3), Apollo.io (2), B2B Lead Enrichment MCP (2), Clari (2), Crustdata (2), GenPark (4), Gong (2), Google (2), HubSpot (3), Lead411 (2), LeadMagic (2), Live Data Technologies (2), Magellan Data (2), MCP (2), MEOK (2), Moltline Outbound (2), Nuph (221), Ocean.io (2), Salesforce (2), SeldonFrame (2), Siftable (10), Terret (2), Vinkius (4), Zapier (2), ZoomInfo (2).
- [Company pages](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/companies/): 3 Why Now account cards at `https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/companies/{slug}/`. SteadyBase fields: account_id (feed only, never acc_ from slug), legal_name, ticker, cik, domain, linkedin_company_url, family, entry_point_account_id (proved parent, else self, else abstain), why_now, executives, mcp_package_hint {slug, page_url, listing_url, mcp_url, ticker?, domain?}. Honesty badges and tool counts are copied from directory.json. mcp_package_hint carries no official status and no tool count. why_now abstains without a verbatim quote and receipt. company-v1 executives stay empty without a filing roster. An enrichment sidecar (enrichment-v1) may add a cited about blurb, a LinkedIn company URL, public-roster executives, GitHub MCP repos, and how_mcp_published prose tied to the directory badge. It never invents official. family stays empty without EX-21 proof. Public-company intel source of record is fin45 / GTM Signals Postgres, not this repo. Schema: `https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/companies/schema/company-page.schema.json`. Sidecar: `https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/companies/schema/company-enrichment.schema.json`.
- [By category](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/categories/): 15 categories with their coverage.
- [By job](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/jobs/): 56 jobs phrased the way an agent asks for them.
- [By MCP status](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/mcp/) and [by access gate](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/gates/).
- [Submit a tool or a correction](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/submit): free, and placement is not for sale.

## The lists, which are the fastest answers to the most common questions

- [The 201 GTM tools with an official MCP server](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/lists/official-mcp-servers): 201 entries. The full list of 201 go to market tools whose vendor ships and maintains its own MCP server, with the server URL, the auth model and the access gate for each. Counted 2026-09-20.
- [The 540 GTM tools with a community MCP server](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/lists/community-mcp-servers): 540 entries. Go to market tools where a working MCP server exists but somebody other than the vendor built it. Counted 2026-09-20 across 1,252 directory entries.
- [The 487 GTM tools with no MCP server found](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/lists/no-mcp-server): 487 entries. 487 of 1,252 go to market tools had no MCP server at the time of the check. What that means, and what it does not mean. Checked through 2026-09-20.
- [The 78 GTM tools a solo operator can call for free](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/lists/free-api-tiers): 78 entries. 78 go to market tools where a solo operator can get API access without talking to anyone. 65 of them also have an MCP server. Counted 2026-09-20.
- [The 168 GTM tools an agent can call and a solo operator can pay for](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/lists/solo-reachable): 168 entries. 168 of 1,252 go to market tools pass both tests at once: an MCP server exists, and API access is free to start or paid self serve. Counted 2026-09-20.
- [The 87 GTM tools that need a contract before an agent can touch them](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/lists/enterprise-gated): 87 entries. 79 enterprise only entries plus 8 enterprise leaning. 41 of them ship an official MCP server that most readers of this page still cannot call. Counted 2026-09-20.
- [GTM MCP servers that use OAuth](https://andrewcmcguire.com/gtm-directory/lists/auth-oauth): 69 entries. 69 of the 741 GTM tools with an MCP server use OAuth. The verbatim auth field for each one is printed beside it. Counted 2026-09-20.

## What this site will not tell you

- Which tool is better. 1 tools have been run by anybody here, so a comparison would be an opinion.
- Prices, credit costs, quota sizes or rate limits. The access gate is tracked; money is not.
- Repo health. github_url, github_stars, github_last_commit and github_archived are null on every entry because the rail that would fill them has not been run. A star count without the date it was taken is a lie.

Built by Andrew McGuire. Agent Operator. The GTM MCP Directory is a product; Agent Operator is the umbrella. Brendan Short's The Signal (https://www.thesignal.club) defines and analyses the GTM engineer role; this is a utility for people doing the job.
